cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you box our allotment photo, admit that summer wasn't wasted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We grew three carrots. I need the shelf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. You got out of bed every morning to water those three carrots with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could put the photo on my desk at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you? And tell people that part when they laugh at the harvest.

mechanism: A professionally corrects the measure and telling of an allotment memory so B acknowledges shared daily effort rather than dismissing a poor harvest.
confusable: D83 tests memory accuracy; D81 asks recognition that remembered relationship or sacrifice mattered, not a quiz answer.
comparison: Receipt alternative preserves B written appreciation of a costly weekend; photo alternative asks B to give shared daily effort its full public account.
seedUse: Allotment photo, three carrots, daily watering and work desk derive from D81-a; S03 adds yield-versus-record correction.
